rows.Create Table:
CREATE TABLE `property_managers` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `company` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(320) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_property_managers_email` (`email`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=93 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `rentals` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `listing_title` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `property_address` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `submitter_email` varchar(320) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `description` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `property_type` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `terms_accepted` tinyint(1) NOT NULL,
  `manager_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `listing_code` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `available_units` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_rentals_listing_code` (`listing_code`),
  KEY `ix_rentals_manager_id` (`manager_id`),
  KEY `ix_rentals_listing_title` (`listing_title`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_rentals_manager` FOREIGN KEY (`manager_id`) REFERENCES `property_managers` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_rentals_address` CHECK ((char_length(trim(`property_address`)) > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_rentals_available_units` CHECK ((`available_units` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_rentals_description` CHECK ((char_length(`description`) >= 26)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_rentals_property_type` CHECK ((`property_type` in (_utf8mb4'apartment',_utf8mb4'house',_utf8mb4'condo',_utf8mb4'townhouse'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_rentals_terms` CHECK ((`terms_accepted` = 1)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_rentals_title` CHECK ((char_length(trim(`listing_title`)) > 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=268 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

managers.sql: SELECT id,name,company,email,created_at,updated_at FROM property_managers ORDER BY id LIMIT 3

rentals.sql: SELECT id,listing_title,listing_code,available_units,manager_id,created_at,updated_at FROM rentals ORDER BY id LIMIT 3
